source.check: the rural council report read in the Frontier Sentinel of 30 May 1964.

note: Triennial election of East Down Rural District Council, polled Thursday 4 June 1964. There was one contest, in a division not named in the report read. Two unopposed returns are named here; the rest of the council is not listed. Returned unopposed in succession to the late Mr. Joe Smyth. Addresses and occupations printed with the names are not reproduced (privacy rule; gap-fill 6 Nov 2026). Returned unopposed.
